epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full stack startup time from >10 minutes to <2 minutes
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to provide a docker-compose configuration, so that the full stack can be launched locally with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local environment without a running product, When the user executes the container stack startup command, Then all services start.
Given all services are started, When the user queries the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a healthy status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce manual environment setup from >5 manual commands to 1 command

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to update or delete materials from >5 minutes to <1 minute
requirements: R1: Add UI capabilities to update and delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Implement UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend management features for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that the catalog can be accurately maintained from the UI.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user submits edited details via the UI, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API endpoint and updates the view.
Given an existing material, When a user confirms deletion via the UI, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and removes it from the view.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce manual API calls for updates and deletes from 100% to 0%

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0 per month
requirements: R1: Implement a standard authentication and session mechanism to block unauthenticated users from accessing or modifying the catalog.

slices.title: Implement authentication mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to add authentication checks, so that restricted data is protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access restricted catalog features, Then they are blocked.
Given a blocked unauthenticated user, When they are blocked, Then they are prompted to log in.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthenticated access rate to restricted endpoints from 100% to 0%
